elsewhere.note: You have shortened the days of his youth. You have covered him with shame.
They will also clothe themselves with sackcloth, and horror will cover them. Shame will be on all faces, and baldness on all their heads.
For the violence done to your brother Jacob, shame will cover you, and you will be cut off forever.
Then my enemy will see it, and shame will cover her who said to me, where is Yahweh your God? Then my enemy will see me and will cover her shame. Now she will…
